claims_about_contribution.why: contribution.md does contain a 'Where it came from, and what is new' section describing the method and its relationship to the prior 'white-bear' steering construction, so characterizing it as covering 'the method and its provenance' is accurate.

rationale: Both documents give the user and the judge the same technical picture: a think-vs-neutral contrast built on the same underlying 'white-bear'/concept-holding axis as a prior think-vs-don't-think construction, with identical quantitative overlap and novelty evidence (0.677 vs 0.608, control directions topping out at 0.21, random/reversed controls, dose sensitivity). The only material difference is that the user is explicitly told the prior work's author name ('Raman') and its location ('papers/'), information the judge's contribution.md never supplies, since contribution.md refers to the prior construction only by the generic term 'white-bear' without attribution.
